AUCTUM GMBH · GERMANY

Equestrian store – complete remaining stock (rider clothing, boots, horse rugs, tack)

Complete remaining stock of an equestrian retailer in the Czech Republic: breeches and riding tights, riding and jodhpur boots, jackets, show jackets and shirts, turnout, stable, cooler and fly rugs, fly masks, saddle pads, bridles, bits, girths, headcollars, horse boots and bandages, helmets and body protectors, grooming, care and stable equipment, dog products and gifts. Brands include QHP, Horseware (Rambo, Amigo, Micklem), HKM, BUSSE, Waldhausen / ELT, Equestro, Acavallo, CATAGO, Equipage, Bucas, USG, Fager, Uhip, Komperdell, CASCO, EKKIA, PS of Sweden, Back on Track and Stars & Stripes. 4,322 products in 6,385 size lines as recorded in the store inventory.
